title: Potion Of Tracer
description: Easily locate any entity through walls! Features a powerful ESP system compatible with Tremors and all standard mobs.
body: ![Potion Of Tracker](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/079ecc3d3c9b18df55fe3883b4e1f8bffa1425d8_0.webp) ## ✨ Potion of Tracer Tired of hearing zombies behind walls but never finding them? Potion of Tracer is a essential utility mod for cave explorers who want to see exactly where the danger (or the loot) is hiding. - 🔍 Overview This mod adds the Tracer Potion, a special brew that grants you the ability to see the glowing outlines of all nearby mobs through solid blocks. It’s like having thermal vision for the Minecraft underworld! - 💡 Perfect for: Map Makers: Use it to test mob placement and visibility in your custom maps. Server Admins: Quickly find entities or hidden mob farms causing lag. Testing: Perfect for players who want to scout out a cave system before committing to a survival run. Safety: Spot that Creeper waiting behind the corner before it ruins your build. - 🛠️ How to use Open your Creative Inventory. Look for the Potion of Tracer (under the Brewings or Combat tab). Drink it and watch the world's entities light up through the walls! - ⚙️ Technical Info Compatibility: Designed for the latest versions of Minecraft. Lightweight: No heavy dependencies or performance drops. Multiplayer: Works on servers to help staff manage entity tracking. - ⚠️ Note: Now we have a recipe for the potion ![Potion Of Tracer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bcf5dfef3c27dacc9b0a7cdff04d1eaf59a39c57.png) ## ❓ FAQ **Q: Does this work on servers?** A: Yes! Both the server and client need the mod installed. **Q: Can I include this in my modpack?** A: Absolutely! Just give credit to the author. ## PLATFORM LINKS
